content.name: Lea Nguyen
content.title: Junior Financial Analyst
content.summary: Finance graduate (M.Sc., Goethe University Frankfurt) with 18 months as a working student in corporate controlling. Prepares monthly reporting for a mid-sized industrial group and built a Python tool that cut the cost-centre report run from two hours to ten minutes.

experience.title: Junior Financial Analyst
bullets: Prepare the monthly controlling report for three business units with combined revenue of €210 million.
Built a Python script that merges SAP cost-centre exports, cutting report preparation from two hours to ten minutes.
Support the 2026 budget by collecting plan data from 22 cost-centre owners and checking it against prior-year actuals.
Analyse raw-material price changes and show their margin impact to the head of controlling every quarter.

experience.title: Working Student, Group Controlling (Werkstudentin)
bullets: Maintained KPI dashboards in Power BI for the CFO office, about 20 hours a week alongside my Master's.
Reconciled actual-versus-plan figures for 40 cost centres each month.
Wrote the user guide for a new allocation template, which the team still uses for onboarding.

education.details: Thesis: hedging of energy price risk in German SMEs; grade 1.6
Exchange semester at the University of Amsterdam

achievements.title: Report run cut to ten minutes
achievements.detail: Python tool for SAP cost-centre exports at Mainfeld Industrietechnik.

achievements.title: Case study winner
achievements.detail: First place in a university valuation case challenge, Goethe University, 2024.
